desktop.notesZh: 批次三十九~四十（确认门一行 + 推进按钮归位 + 影响范围按文件判定 + GitLab 测试更新 + 计时只算模型 + 确认门同步 + 金色选中框）：① 确认门的全部选项按钮排在同一行（三个选项的门不再折成两行，按钮等分宽度、标签在按钮内换行）；② 流程图右上角工具条的「推进」按钮补回原位——以前不可推进时它整个消失，工具条上就空着一个位置，看着像少了个按钮；现在常驻，不可推进时置灰，悬停说明还差什么；模型正在跑的时候它整个隐藏（正在推进的工作流没有可确认的东西）；③ 影响范围改为按「文件」判定：默认「待确定」，随着流程推进把改动到的文件收进悬停与变更详情，都在一个目录下读作「模块内」，跨目录读作「跨模块」（判定按目录而不是文件数）；④ 会话耗时只统计大模型真正在跑的时间：改用 session 日志的回合区间（turn/start→turn/end）度量，确认门等待、流程暂停、停掉模型、客户走开一律不计——卡在设计阶段的变更不再显示「704m6s」这种一直涨的数；阶段卡之和与顶部数字按构造相等（完成卡改标「合计」，顶栏 token 改读逐节点汇总）；⑤ 会话里的确认门与工作流图的确认门同步取消：会话里选「暂不推进」，图上的横幅不再弹回来，此时图上只剩「推进」按钮；会话里停模型等于工作流暂停，会话里打「继续」等于工作流继续；⑥ 确认门弹窗只覆盖会话区域，找不到会话面板时内联渲染，左侧栏不再被全屏遮罩挡住；⑦ 选中的阶段卡换成金色光环（原来是一圈很丑的近黑细框），运行中的卡片脉冲加强；⑧ 启动页「首次启动耗时」提示与 logo 的间距收紧到 18px，窗口收回 380×324；⑨ 新增 GitLab 测试更新的一条命令：npm run publish-release-gitlab（先 build-release，再用项目 token 发到 ai/workflow/baf-dsh 的通用包仓库并挂成 release link），桌面端「检查更新」读的就是这条通道。
desktop.notesEn: Batches 39~40 (one-row gate options + the advance button back in place + the scope judged by files + a GitLab test update + a clock that counts only the model + gates that cancel in sync + a gold selection frame): the gate card's options all ride on ONE row (a three-option gate no longer folds onto a second line — the buttons share the width and the labels wrap inside); the flow graph's top-right toolbar keeps its 推进 button — it used to vanish whenever the change could not advance, leaving an empty slot that read as a missing button; it is always there now, disabled when it cannot run, with the missing reason on its title, and it is GONE entirely while the model is running (a workflow mid-turn has nothing to confirm); the 影响范围 is judged by the FILES now: 待确定 by default, and as the change progresses the touched files land in the hover and in the change detail — one directory reads as 模块内, several directories as 跨模块 (directories, not file count); the 会话耗时 counts only the time the model actually ran — measured against the session log's turn brackets (turn/start→turn/end), so a confirmation-gate wait, a workflow pause, a stopped model and the customer's absence never land in it: a change parked in 设计 no longer reads 「704m6s」 and keeps climbing; the stage cards add up to the top strip by construction (the terminal card is labelled 合计, the strip's token cell reads the per-node rollup); the session's confirmation dialog and the workflow graph's cancel in sync now — answering 暂不推进 in the conversation no longer lets the graph's banner come back, and the 推进 button is left as the way forward; stopping the model in the conversation IS the workflow's pause, and typing 继续 IS its resume; the confirmation modal covers the conversation area only — with no conversation pane to pin to it renders inline, so the left sidebar is never blocked; the selected stage card wears a gold halo (it used to be an ugly near-black hairline frame) and the running card's pulse is stronger; the splash's slow-start hint now clears the mark by 18px and the window is back to 380×324; a GitLab test update now has one command — npm run publish-release-gitlab (build-release, then a project token publishes the artifacts to the generic package registry of ai/workflow/baf-dsh and attaches them as release links) — and that channel is what the desktop updater reads.
